title.zh: 补充缴费养老金第 2 号修正命令 2014
title.en: SUPPLEMENTAL CONTRIBUTORY PENSIONS AMENDMENT NO. 2 ORDER 2014

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-30-2014-SUPPLEMENTAL-CONTRIBUTORY-PENSIONS-AMENDMENT-NO.-2-ORDER-2014.pdf》（2 页），本次切分 4 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Supplemental Contributory Pensions (Amendment) (No.2) Order, 2014 and shall commence on 1st April2014. of section 1 of S 58/2009.

the Supplemental Contributory Pensions Order, in this Order referred to as the principal Order, is amended, in subsection (2). by deleting "to and incorp~rate the Supplemental Contributory Pensions Board," from the first and second lines. of section 2.

Section 2 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection (1), by deleting the definition of "Board" and by substituting the following new definition means the Lembaga Tabung Amanah Pekerja established under section 3 of the Tabung Amanah Pekerja Act [Chapter 167);". of sections 3 and 4.

The principal Order is amended by repealing sections 3 and 4. Made this 6th. day of Sya'aban, 1435 Hijriah corresponding to the 4th. day of June, 2014 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM Dicetak oleh PENGIRAN HAJI ZAINAL ABIDIN BIN PENGIRAN SERI WIJAYA PENGIRAN HAJI AHMAD, Pengarah Percetakan, di Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam.
